name: trollfjord
description: MS Trollfjord (2002), a Hurtigruten coastal-express ship on the Bergen-Kirkenes route: black hull with a red band, white superstructure of stepped decks, funnel aft of amidships, bridge far forward. Built for the harbour scene at Aalesund, seen from 60 m to 2 km. No company logo or wordmark; the ship's name is on the bows and the stern.

reference.sourced: Wikipedia 'MS Trollfjord': LOA 135.75 m, beam 21.5 m, height 29.9 m, draught 5.1 m, 16,140 GT, 1,180 t deadweight, 15 kn cruising / 18 kn maximum, two Waertsilae 9L32 diesels 2 x 5,630 hp, two Rolls-Royce Aquamaster Contaz 35 azimuth thrusters and bow thrusters, 822 passengers, 45 cars, 10 decks (7 passenger decks), built 2002 by Fosen Mek. Verksteder, Rissa. Deltamarin project sheet 'Trollfjord' (deltamarin.com, trollfjord.pdf): LOA 135.75 m, beam 21.50 m, draught 4.90 m, 1,186 t dwt, 16,140 GT, 'pram-type hull form, trim wedge and azimuth thruster propulsion', DNV ice class 1C, shore power.
reference.geometry_source: No lines or general arrangement are public. Heights and stations are read off two Wikimedia Commons photos viewed in a browser: a near-broadside starboard view at Bergen (2021-07-30) and a head-on view ('MS Trollfjord midt imot'). Read off: freeboard to the top of the red band about 7.3 m (black topside about 5.5 m), the red band about 2 m deep (dipping in a V at the stem), a red antifouling line showing at the waterline, five white tiers above the hull stepping back at the stern, the bridge with enclosed wings about 8 m aft of the stem, a two-deck glass panorama lounge above and aft of the bridge, two enclosed lifeboats per side in recesses amidships, a small rescue boat in a recess of the starboard hull side, the funnel about 35 % of the length from the stern, the name in white letters on the bows just under the red band. A stern-quarter photo ('MS Trollfjord legger til') shows the aft superstructure as one block with a rounded aft end, near-vertical, the window rows wrapping round it.
reference.assumed: Everything not in 'sourced' is ASSUMED: hull lines, the bulb, appendages, deck heights (photo readings, about +-1 m), the whole mass budget, equipment dimensions, colours. The 'height 29.9 m' is read as the air draught above the design waterline (the photo puts the funnel top about 31 m above it). Twin azimuth thrusters are SOURCED; their size, the single pulling propeller per unit and the thruster count forward/aft are ASSUMED.

units: SI: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds. Keys ending in _deg are degrees.

frame.origin: On the centreline, on the moulded baseline (flat of keel, y = 0), halfway along the length overall (stem top x = +67.875, transom x = -67.875).
frame.appendages_below_baseline: None; the azimuth units hang under the raised pram stern and stay above the baseline.
frame.gltf: trollfjord.glb is Y-up, same axes and metres as this frame. Node 'trollfjord' is the root and sits at identity.

principal.draft_note: SOURCED 5.1 m draught (Wikipedia); Deltamarin gives 4.90 m. Read as the maximum draft (flat keel to the waterline) at the departure condition; the generator asserts the solved draft within hydrostatics.draft_tolerance.
principal.beam_note: SOURCED 21.5 m moulded beam; the hull half-breadth amidships is 10.75.
principal.height_note: ASSUMED: highest point (aft masthead) about 35 m above the baseline = 29.9 m air draught above a 5.1 m waterline.

hull.note: ASSUMED lines of a pram-sterned coastal RoPax. Tables are (x, value), interpolated by a monotone cubic (pchip). keel = centreline bottom (rises into the pram stern and up the raked stem); half_breadth_low = half-breadth at the antifouling top (paint.antifouling_top_y); half_breadth_deck = at the deck edge (flare forward); fullness = superellipse exponent of the underwater section (8 = flat bottom and tight bilge, 2 = elliptic V); deck_edge_y = height of the deck edge (sheer).

bulb.note: ASSUMED bulbous bow: ellipsoid-like body of revolution about a horizontal axis, its aft part buried in the forefoot.

forecastle_bulwark.note: white bulwark round the open forecastle mooring deck, from x0 to the stem

paint.note: SOURCED colours (photos): red antifouling showing at the waterline, black hull, a red band at the top of the hull that dips in a V at the stem. ASSUMED levels. The antifouling top and the black top are hull vertices, so the paint lines are exact edges.

hull_details.note: ASSUMED positions (photos): a row of small square windows in the black hull under the red band, anchor pockets, bow-thruster tunnel mouths, a side car door on both sides aft, a stern door, the rescue-boat recess on the starboard side amidships.

superstructure.note: ASSUMED from the photos. Tiers are vertical prisms of a plan outline: straight sides at half_width, a rounded front of length front_len (superellipse front_power), the aft end (aft_len > 0) a superellipse of length aft_len (aft_power) so decks 4-7 form one block whose aft face curves round the stern (stern-quarter photo 'MS Trollfjord legger til', Wikimedia Commons), each deck ending 0.4 m forward of the one below (a gentle rake), window panes wrapping the curve (aft_windows); tiers without aft_len have a square aft end with corner chamfers. clip_to_deck keeps a tier inside the hull deck edge (plus clip_margin) near the bow. Recesses cut the side in plan (lifeboat bays). Each tier's window rows are decals (own dark-glass material) offset window_offset outward.

roof_rail.note: rail round the open deck of each tier's roof where the tier above steps back (drawn round the whole roof edge; hidden where a tier stands on it)

bridge_wings.note: enclosed bridge wings reaching past the hull side (head-on photo)

sign_board.note: the yellow name board beside the funnel, as a plain panel (no lettering)

funnel.note: ASSUMED sizes from the side photo: black funnel on a white casing about 35 % of the length from the stern, three exhaust pipes, a slight rake aft. No emblem.

mast.note: ASSUMED. Forward radar mast on the panorama deck roof, aft mast against the funnel front carrying the aft masthead light (higher than the forward one, COLREG).

lifeboats.note: SOURCED arrangement (photos): two enclosed lifeboats per side in bays of deck 6 amidships, orange canopy over a white hull; a small rescue boat in a recess of the starboard hull. ASSUMED sizes.

propulsion.note: SOURCED: two azimuth thrusters (Aquamaster Contaz 35), bow thrusters, two diesels of 5,630 hp each, 15 kn cruising, 18 kn maximum. ASSUMED: positions, sizes, thrust, and one pulling propeller per unit in the model. The azimuth units are the 'rudder_port'/'rudder_stbd' nodes (they steer about local +Y); each propeller is a child of its unit.

lights.note: COLREG positions for a power-driven vessel over 50 m; ASSUMED heights.

mooring.note: ASSUMED bollard positions on the forecastle and the aft mooring deck.

bridge.note: conning position at the centre of the bridge front, eye height 1.6 m over the deck 6 floor

ship_name.note: The ship's name in white on both bows just under the red band (head-on photo) and on the stern. Text geometry, not a logo.

mass.note: ASSUMED component budget, sized so the departure condition floats at the sourced draught with a block coefficient near 0.6 and a KG about 10.3 m (passenger ship). Deadweight SOURCED 1,186 t (Deltamarin): full_load = lightship + 1,186 t; departure = lightship + 850 t.

budget.item: accommodation outfit in the hull (crew cabins, car deck fittings)
funnel, masts, lifeboats, davits, deck machinery

mass.inertia_note: ASSUMED radii of gyration: roll 0.38 B, pitch and yaw 0.25 L about the CoM.

cars and cargo on the car deck

hydrostatics.note: Computed by the generator from the buoyant closed meshes (hull shell, bulb) with the Mariner's winding-number column integrator. Written to trollfjord_hydro.json.

materials.note: Linear RGB. ASSUMED albedos after the photos.
